milestones.title: Punch a tree
milestones.hint: Hold left click on a log to break it.

milestones.title: Workbench
milestones.hint: Open your pack (E) and craft a crafting table from planks.

milestones.title: Getting tools
milestones.hint: Near a crafting table, make a wooden pickaxe.

milestones.title: Stone age
milestones.hint: Mine stone and make a stone pickaxe.

milestones.title: First fire
milestones.hint: Craft a furnace from 8 cobble, then smelt a log into coal for torches.

milestones.title: Charcoal
milestones.hint: Smelt a log in the furnace to make coal. One log makes four torches.

milestones.title: Light the dark
milestones.hint: Light the dark: place a torch. Shades cannot rise in the light.

milestones.title: Iron age
milestones.hint: Smelt raw iron in a furnace.

milestones.title: Ember
milestones.hint: Mine emberstone deep underground with an iron pickaxe.

milestones.title: Home
milestones.hint: Craft a bed. Right click it to make it your spawn point.

milestones.title: Storage
milestones.hint: Craft a chest to share items with friends.

milestones.title: Hot meal
milestones.hint: Cook raw meat in a furnace.

milestones.title: Deep digger
milestones.hint: Make an iron pickaxe to mine emberstone.

milestones.title: Safe ground
milestones.hint: Craft and place a hearth: no Shade can come within 16 blocks of it.

npcs.name: Old Brannoc
npcs.title: Hearthkeeper
npcs.greeting: The Great Hearth kept this valley safe for three hundred years. Now look at it: a ring of cold stones. Sit, warm your hands on what's left, and listen.

npcs.name: Captain Maren
npcs.title: Captain of the Watch
npcs.greeting: Keep your blade close and your torch closer. The dark has teeth now.

npcs.name: Tilda
npcs.title: Cook
npcs.greeting: Hungry? Everyone's hungry. Nobody brings me anything to cook.

npcs.name: Hollis
npcs.title: Smith
npcs.greeting: Hammer's ready. Iron isn't. Never is.

npcs.name: Sergeant Holt
npcs.title: The North Watch
npcs.greeting: The beacon still burns, barely. Everything past this tower belongs to the boars and the dark.

npcs.name: Foreman Garrick
npcs.title: Logging Camp
npcs.greeting: Axes down, everyone, unless you fancy a tusk through the leg. Those boars got bold.

npcs.name: Farmer Ostrin
npcs.title: Ostrin's Farm
npcs.greeting: Bandits in my fields, crabs in my ditches. Good thing the mill still turns.

npcs.name: Old Wenna
npcs.title: Fisher's Landing
npcs.greeting: The lake gives and the lake takes. Lately it only takes.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Bree
npcs.title: Miner's Rest
npcs.greeting: Supplies are short, the road's cut, and nobody will go back down that mine.

npcs.name: Prospector Dunmore
npcs.title: Miner's Rest
npcs.greeting: Something lit candles down in the Hollow. Something that isn't us.

npcs.name: Corporal Ansel
npcs.title: Ashcloak Stockade
npcs.greeting: With Rook Varn dead, the Watch holds this stockade. The East Road breathes again, thanks to you.

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.title: Street Sweeper
npcs.greeting: Mind the dust. And the boots. Especially the boots.

npcs.name: Odo
npcs.title: Greengrocer
npcs.greeting: Fresh from Ostrin's fields this morning. Well. Yesterday morning.

npcs.name: Bram
npcs.title: Townsman
npcs.greeting: Three hundred years that hearth burned. I give it three more, with you about.

npcs.name: Ilsa
npcs.title: Townswoman
npcs.greeting: Sit a while. The stones are still warm if you believe hard enough.

npcs.name: Tam
npcs.title: Lumberjack
npcs.greeting: Birch splits clean. Oak fights back. I respect oak.

npcs.name: Wyn
npcs.title: Lumberjack
npcs.greeting: Garrick says axes down. Garrick isn't the one behind on his cords.

npcs.name: Guard Edric
npcs.title: North Watch
npcs.greeting: Quiet night. I don't trust quiet nights.

npcs.name: Jory
npcs.title: Farmhand
npcs.greeting: Ostrin says the mill grinds, the hands rake. So I rake.

npcs.name: Old Marl
npcs.title: Fisherman
npcs.greeting: Hush. You'll scare the supper.

npcs.name: Dag
npcs.title: Miner
npcs.greeting: Coal's shallow here. Iron's deep. Candlekin are deeper. Guess which I dig.

npcs.name: Sela
npcs.title: Wayfarer
npcs.greeting: East road's no place to walk alone. So I walk it quickly.

npcs.name: Carter Hobb
npcs.title: Carter
npcs.greeting: A good wagon, that was. Forty years. Then Ashcloaks.

npcs.name: Guard Tolan
npcs.title: Hearthstead Watch
npcs.greeting: Tower's sound. It's the roads I'd watch.

npcs.name: Rysa
npcs.title: Hunter
npcs.greeting: Webs between the roots, thick as rope. Don't touch them.

npcs.name: Anwen
npcs.title: Lorekeeper
npcs.greeting: The stones are older than the hearth. Whatever sleeps under them is older still.

npcs.name: Brother Calder
npcs.title: Lamplighter
npcs.greeting: A light at the door, every night. It's all that keeps them in.

npcs.name: Tess
npcs.title: Angler
npcs.greeting: Mirrormere gives if you're patient. Takes, if you wade.

npcs.name: Oswin
npcs.title: Pilgrim
npcs.greeting: They built it to stand in the water. I like to think they knew why.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.title: Night Watch
npcs.greeting: Six by the fire, two on the gate. Stay behind my light.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.title: Surveyor
npcs.greeting: Shaft's sound enough. It's what moved in that isn't.

npcs.name: Ruk
npcs.title: Miner
npcs.greeting: Sit. Breathe. The dust settles if you let it.

npcs.name: Nim
npcs.title: Forager
npcs.greeting: Red caps for stew, pale caps for sleep. Don't mix them up. I did once.

npcs.name: Poll
npcs.title: Gardener
npcs.greeting: Beans by the tower wall, where the stone holds the warmth.

npcs.name: Wat
npcs.title: Shepherd
npcs.greeting: Count them going out, count them coming in. Some nights the sums differ.

npcs.name: Carter Jeb
npcs.title: Carter
npcs.greeting: Legs tired? I drive to anywhere you've already walked to. I don't go looking for new places.

npcs.name: Carter Nan
npcs.title: Carter
npcs.greeting: Timber goes out, people come back. Been somewhere on foot? Then I can take you.

npcs.name: Carter Pip
npcs.title: Carter
npcs.greeting: Flour to town twice a day. There's room on the sacks, if you know where you're going.

npcs.name: Ferryman Corwin
npcs.title: Carter
npcs.greeting: Boat's laid up, but the cart still runs. Anywhere you've been, for a few coppers.

npcs.name: Carter Ada
npcs.title: Carter
npcs.greeting: Ore went west, once. Now it's just people who've had enough. Where to?

quests.title: The Cold Hearth
quests.text: You've woken by the old hearth like the rest of us, I see. Shades took the valley the night the Great Hearth went out. If you mean to help, Captain Maren keeps what's left of the Watch. Go and speak with her.
quests.done: Brannoc sent you? Good. We need every pair of hands.

quests.title: Meat for the Pot
quests.text: Grazers wander the meadows around Hearthstead. Bring me 6 pieces of raw meat and I'll make sure nobody fights on an empty stomach.
quests.done: Lovely. Here, take some of yesterday's.

quests.title: Thinning the Herd
quests.text: The Grazers have grown bold without the Watch to drive them off, and they trample our gardens. Thin the herd: 8 of them should do. The nearest flocks graze just outside the gates.
quests.done: That's better. Take one of these. You've earned it.

quests.title: Kindling
quests.text: If we are ever to relight the Great Hearth we will need wood. Bring me 8 logs from the woods. Trees grow back here, faster than you'd think.
quests.done: Good, dry wood. Take this pick. The stone will need breaking too.

quests.title: Wool for Winter
quests.text: Nights are cold and blankets are thin. Grazer wool, 8 bundles of it, and I'll stitch something warm.
quests.done: Soft as anything. Take this. A bed of your own, so you wake somewhere better than the hearth.

quests.title: Coal for the Watch
quests.text: Light keeps the Shades back, and torches need coal. There is a seam in the rocks outside the west gate, and more at the Old Quarry north-west of the town: look for black-flecked stone and bring me 6 coal. Your wooden pick will do for coal.
quests.done: Torches for the Watch, and some for you. Shades cannot rise in good light.

quests.title: The North Watch
quests.text: Before the dark came, we kept a beacon north of here. Follow the north road to it, and if Sergeant Holt still holds the watch there, give him my orders and do what he asks.
quests.progress: The Captain sent you? Find the beacon first: it is right behind me.
quests.done: Still burning, and so are we. Maren's orders, is it? Then there's work for you here.

quests.title: Eyes in the Dark
quests.text: Shades rise when the sun goes down, and in deep caves at any hour. They cannot cross into a hearth's light: fight from the fire here if you can. Destroy 5 of them.
quests.progress: Wait for dusk, or go below. They'll come.
quests.done: Five fewer pairs of eyes. You fight like a Watchman.

quests.title: Iron for Hollis
quests.text: The Old Quarry has iron too: rust-red flecks beside the coal. You'll want a stone pickaxe (Old Brannoc gives one for kindling, or I sell them) and a little practice: dig coal until your Mining reaches 5. Bring me 6 raw iron and I'll show you what a forge can do.
quests.done: Good ore. Here, a proper pick, from my own anvil.

quests.title: Dust of Shadows
quests.text: When a Shade comes apart it leaves dust behind. In the old days we fed that dust to the Great Hearth and it burned brighter for it. Bring me 8.
quests.done: Feel how cold it is? Cold enough to burn.

quests.title: The Hearth Stirs
quests.text: It's time. Wood to catch, coal to hold the heat, dust to wake it. 20 logs, 10 coal and 6 shade dust, and we will see if the old fire remembers us.
quests.done: ...There. Do you see it? A spark, deep in the stones. The Great Hearth is not dead. It is only sleeping. The Hollow Mines to the east hold what we need next. But that is a story for another day.

quests.title: Feed the Watchfire
quests.text: The watchfire eats coal. There is a seam in the Beacon Rocks, a stone's throw east of the tower: bring me 3 coal and it burns through the night.
quests.done: Hear that crackle? That's the sound of the dark backing off.

quests.title: Boar Trouble
quests.text: Thornboars charge anything on the north road. Six fewer would make it walkable again.
quests.done: Road's clearer already. Take your pick from the armoury.

quests.title: Garrick's Camp
quests.text: West of here Foreman Garrick runs the logging camp. He sent for help two days ago. Go.

quests.title: Tusks and Tempers
quests.text: Bring me five thornboar tusks. The lads want proof the beasts can bleed.
quests.done: Ha! Look at the size of that one.

quests.title: Silk for the Mill
quests.text: Ostrin's mill sails are in tatters. The silk from the websnares at the Hollow Oak is the strongest thread there is. Six bundles.
quests.done: Strong as rope. Ostrin will be grateful.

quests.title: Into Barrowwood
quests.text: The woods past the Hollow Oak have gone grey and dead. Find the old barrow at their heart and tell me what you see.
quests.done: A barrow with the stones pushed outward? Then something climbed out.

quests.title: The Barrow Warden (Group)
quests.text: Whatever rose from that barrow wears the old warden's helm. End it. Take friends.
quests.done: Then the barrow sleeps again. For now.

quests.title: Bread for the Mill
quests.text: Farmer Ostrin owes me flour. Walk south to his farm and see what's keeping him.

quests.title: Thieves in the Fields
quests.text: Ashcloak bandits raid my fields at all hours. Drive five of them off for good.
quests.done: That'll teach them. Mostly.

quests.title: Stolen Grain
quests.text: They carried off my grain in sacks. Bring back six and Tilda gets her flour.
quests.done: Every sack, near enough. You've a farmer's patience.

quests.title: Down to the Water
quests.text: Old Wenna at Fisher's Landing could use a strong arm more than I can. Follow the shore west.

quests.title: Pincher Supper
quests.text: Mirepinchers have eaten every fish in the shallows. Return the favour: six portions of claw meat.
quests.done: We'll eat well tonight.

quests.title: Clear the Shallows
quests.text: Seven mirepinchers, and my nets are safe again.
quests.done: The water's quiet. Thank you.

quests.title: The Drowned Light
quests.text: At night a light burns under the water to the south-east. My grandmother said a hearth stood there before the lake. Go and look.
quests.done: An older hearth, drowned. So ours was not the first.

quests.title: Wisps on the Water
quests.text: Gloomwisps drift over the shrine and lure fishers to drown. Put out four of them.
quests.done: The water's dark again. Good dark.

quests.title: Word from the East
quests.text: My ore came from Miner's Rest, east past the bridge. No shipment in a week. Find Quartermaster Bree and ask why. Mind the caravan on the road.

quests.title: Ambush on the East Road
quests.text: Ashcloaks hit every cart on the road. Six of them, and we can move supplies again.
quests.done: The road's ours again.

quests.title: Their Stockade
quests.text: The Ashcloaks hole up in a stockade south of the road. Scout it out.
quests.done: Banners from Hearthstead as rugs? They've been at this a while.

quests.title: Rook Varn
quests.text: Their leader, Rook Varn, wears a red sash and fights like ten men. End him and the band breaks. He keeps two Cutthroats at his side: bring a friend, or pull them one at a time.
quests.done: Without Varn they'll scatter. You've earned this.

quests.title: Candles in the Dark
quests.text: The Candlekin took the upper galleries. Eight of them, and my lads might go back down.
quests.done: Wax everywhere. Disgusting little things.

quests.title: Wax and Ore
quests.text: Bring up eight lumps of their wax and four of raw iron. Proof the seams are workable.
quests.done: Good iron, and wax to light the next shift.

quests.title: The Hollow Foreman (Group)
quests.text: Something wears the old foreman's coat in the Deep Seam and gives the Candlekin their orders. Gather a party of three and finish it.
quests.done: The Hollow is ours. Hearthstead will hear of this.

quests.title: The Broken Tower
quests.text: There's an old watchtower on the south road, three minutes out. Something has been moving in it after dark. Walk down, look it over and tell me what you see.
quests.progress: South gate, then follow the road. You can't miss it.
quests.done: Empty? Good. Empty is the best news I've had this week.

quests.title: The Lay of the Land
quests.text: If you're to be any use to the Watch, learn the meadow. Three places: the Old Quarry to the north-west, the Trapper's Camp on the west trail, and the wreck of Hobb's wagon on the east road. Go and stand in each.
quests.done: Now you know the ground better than half my men. Take these: you've walked enough to need them.

quests.title: A Lookout's Eye
quests.text: From the hill up the road you can see the whole of Birchrise. Climb to the lookout and count the boar packs, so I know what we're up against.
quests.progress: Up the north road. The viewpoint is on the left.
quests.done: That many? Then the boars are your next job.

quests.title: Word for the Hunter
quests.text: Rysa hunts out by the Hollow Oak, west along the trail. Tell her the camp will pay for every Websnare she clears. And mind the webs.
quests.done: Garrick pays now? Then stay: there's more here than I can shoot.

quests.title: Webs Between the Roots
quests.text: They nest under the Hollow Oak and come out along the roots. Kill 8 Websnares. If a big pale one comes down the trunk, that's the Silkmother: don't fight her alone.
quests.done: The wood's quieter already. Take your pick.

quests.title: The Forgotten Graves
quests.text: The graves north of here are older than the Barrow. Calder lights a lamp there every night. Find the graves, then find him, and ask what he has seen.
quests.progress: Have you stood among the graves?
quests.done: Seen? The Warden walks, that's what I've seen. Somebody ought to put him back.

quests.title: Know the Vale
quests.text: The Great Hearth once lit the whole vale, pass to shore. Before we relight it, someone must see what it will shine on. Stand at the North Pass, at the Barrow Overlook in the west, on the shore before the Sunken Shrine in the south, and at the Ridge Cut in the east. It is a long road: take it as it comes, and take a friend past the bridge.
quests.progress: North, west, south, east. The vale is bigger than it looks from here.
quests.done: Pass to shore, and back alive. Then wear something worthy of it.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.blurb: A master of arms in mail. Builds rage by fighting; stands at the front and takes the blows.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.blurb: A holy warrior in mail: fights up close, heals, and is a bane to Shades.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.blurb: A tracker and archer in leather who strikes from afar and pins foes in place.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.blurb: A quick blade in leather. Builds combo points with strikes and spends them on finishers.

classes.name: Priest
classes.blurb: A healer in cloth who mends wounds and burns Shades with holy fire.

classes.name: Mage
classes.blurb: A wielder of fire and frost in cloth: great damage from range, but fragile.

abilities.name: Heroic Blow
abilities.text: A mighty strike: weapon damage plus a little more.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.text: Your cry steels you: 10% more damage for 2 minutes.

abilities.name: Onrush
abilities.text: Rush to your target, stun it for 1 second and gain 10 rage.

abilities.name: Rending Cut
abilities.text: Open a wound that bleeds for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.text: Slam the earth, hurting every foe within 5 yards.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.text: Take 30% less damage for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Judging Blow
abilities.text: Strike with holy might: weapon damage plus more. Shades take 50% more.

abilities.name: Holy Mend
abilities.text: Heal your wounds.

abilities.name: Valour
abilities.text: Fight with valour: 10% more damage for 5 minutes.

abilities.name: Rebuke
abilities.text: Stun your target for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Devout Ward
abilities.text: Take 30% less damage for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Hallowed Ground
abilities.text: Holy light sears all foes within 6 yards; Shades take double.

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.text: A fast, aimed shot.

abilities.name: Barbed Arrow
abilities.text: An arrow that keeps cutting for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Snare Shot
abilities.text: Pin your target in place for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Hawk's Eye
abilities.text: Sharpen your aim: 15% more damage for 30 minutes.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.text: Rain arrows on every foe within 5 yards of your target.

abilities.name: Vicious Strike
abilities.text: Weapon damage plus a little more. Adds a combo point.

abilities.name: Finishing Cut
abilities.text: A finisher: damage for each combo point.

abilities.name: Low Blow
abilities.text: Stun your target for 3 seconds. Adds a combo point.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.text: A finisher: attack 30% faster for 6 seconds, plus 3 per combo point.

abilities.name: Open Vein
abilities.text: A finisher: the target bleeds for 12 seconds, more for each combo point.

abilities.name: Slip Away
abilities.text: Take 50% less damage for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.text: Holy fire burns your target. Shades take double.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.text: Close your wounds.

abilities.name: Withering Word
abilities.text: Shadow eats at your target for 18 seconds.

abilities.name: Renewal
abilities.text: Heal yourself over 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Fortify
abilities.text: +5 Stamina for 30 minutes.

abilities.name: Radiance
abilities.text: Light bursts from you: foes within 8 yards burn (Shades greatly) and you are healed.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.text: Hurl a ball of fire.

abilities.name: Scholar's Focus
abilities.text: +5 Intellect for 30 minutes.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.text: An instant burst of flame.

abilities.name: Ice Ring
abilities.text: Frost holds every foe within 6 yards in place for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text: Step through the air, 10 yards forward.

abilities.name: Flame Nova
abilities.text: A ring of fire burns every foe within 6 yards.
